title: St. Elizabeth of Hungary, Religious
subtitle: Memorial · Rev 3:1-6, 14-22; Lk 19:1-10
text: A king's daughter who nursed the sick with her own hands, St. Elizabeth of Hungary was widowed at 20, used her dowry to build a hospital at Marburg, and died at 24. Like Zacchaeus in today's Gospel, she gave to the poor. Give something real today.
imageAlt: Watercolor of St. Elizabeth of Hungary, crowned and haloed in jeweled robes, opening her cloak as roses fall at her feet, with a kneeling young man in armor before her in a golden palace
credit: Gustave Moreau, Saint Elizabeth of Hungary (The Miracle of the Roses), 1879, watercolor on paper. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
